title: land keeps the worker's worktree until the push step passes
goal: land removes the worker's worktree only after the push step passes, and its help says so; ST-yywctl35's landing removed it, then stopped at the push, and the worktree had to be added back by hand to resume the worker

run:
import subprocess, sys
o = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/backlog.py", "land", "--help"], capture_output=True, text=True)
ok = o.returncode == 0 and "keeps the worker" in " ".join(o.stdout.split())
print("ok" if ok else "land --help does not say it keeps the worker's worktree until the push passes"); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
